test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six persons appeared for an examination. Nripesh scored more than Manasi and Anshika, but less than Leena. Only two persons scored more than Nripesh. Sambit scored less than Nagen, but not the lowest marks. Only two persons scored less than Manasi.

Which of the following statements is definitely FALSE?

options.text: Nagen scored more marks than Nripesh.
Sambit scored more marks than Manasi.
Leena scored the second highest marks.

solution:
1) Nripesh scored more than Manasi and Anshika, but less than Leena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39c6ebb2a82bef4bf3ab6453b810ece1472f0568e91909c01d13a7d5daffe2ec.png] 

 2) Only two persons scored more than Nripesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baadd0fba8d4624ef3dea1ccbafd38f600e928fddefb9e3cb8fb393fbbc2d79b.png] 

3) Sambit scored less than Nagen, but not the lowest marks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/719ff3f2a197e22ae509a483acb2553f4a48952b45c97de10375ce107d116b36.png] 

4) Only two persons scored less than Manasi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2aa738950efef04eca81cd39435d8ad8a6f39f53fd71ef8f882f3ee7aa014b9.png] 

After combining (2) and (4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ce4c73660492633c19c349bb785db34705df14d73ef37712dead22d0781b18.png] 

After combining (1) and (3)

Anshika scored less than Nirpesh and Sambit did not get the lowest marks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c206d8cbb0f4c6923da61047ff1e0df668e3e5be6e1d320b3f35a6fb65a20d89.png] 

Sambit can not be placed at last position because he did not get lowest marks.

Sambit can not be placed at first position because he got lesser marks than Nagen.

The only left position for Sambit is second last.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6beb9e718d65c087b2f8befe2bb4c65b879381a73d3ca13b918d6c1fa68f3d8e.png] 

Anshika got less than Nirpesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/850bba9bf41fda4002bb4815f4f75c260f7cc91d0bd6f5441be7f55593f8b8ab.png] 

Nagen will be on first position because he got higher marks than Sambit and also this the vaccant position.

This is the final order of persons according to marks (descending order).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed93006e5f5131e2434bd96be0b2dcea02f875d9aad6d99af45cab8a3dc46d24.png] 

Sambit scored more marks than Manasi -** False.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**
